page.overview:
What is Leaf Stone?

A is an item introduced in Generation I.

The Leaf Stone is a green elliptical-shape stone on which the shape of a leaf is engraved. It evolves the following Pokémon:

RB/Yl;; Items; 2,100; 1,500; N/A GS/C;; Items; N/A; 1,050; Evolves certain kinds of POKéMON. RS/E; Bag Leaf Stone sprite; Items; N/A; 1,050; Makes certain species of POKéMON evolve. FRLG; Bag Leaf Stone sprite; Items; N/A; 1,050; A peculiar stone that makes certain species of POKéMON evolve. It has a leaf pattern. DP/Pt/HGSS/W; Bag Leaf Stone sprite; Items; N/A; 1,050; A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a leaf pattern. Bl; Bag Leaf Stone sprite; Items; 10,000; 1,050; A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a leaf pattern. B2W2; Bag Leaf Stone sprite; Items; 1,000; 1,050; A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a leaf pattern. XY; Bag Leaf Stone sprite; Items; 2,100; 1,050; A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has an unmistakable leaf pattern. ORAS; Bag Leaf Stone sprite; Items; N/A; 1,050; A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has an unmistakable leaf pattern. SM/USUM; Bag Leaf Stone sprite; Items; 3,000; 1,500; A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has an unmistakable leaf pattern. PE; Bag Leaf Stone sprite; Items; 5,000; 2,500; A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has an unmistakable leaf pattern. SwSh; Bag Leaf Stone sprite; Other Items; N/A; 1,500; A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has an unmistakable leaf pattern. BDSP; Bag Leaf Stone sprite; Other Items; N/A; 1,050; A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has an unmistakable leaf pattern. SV; Leaf Stone SV; Other Items; 3,000; 750; A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has an unmistakable leaf pattern.
